ios.desc:
RightHear is a virtual accessibility assistant that helps people understand where they are and what’s around them – in both new and familiar places.

We’re here to empower individuals who are blind, visually impaired, or face orientation challenges to navigate independently, confidently, and on their own terms – anytime, anywhere.

quotes.text:
Hi, I want to introduce you "Right-hear".
"Right-hear" is a Virtual Orientation Assistant app for the Blind and Visually Impaired.
give blind and visually impaired people the confidence and independence to move freely in public spaces just like every other person.
check out how its work at McDonald's: https://youtu.be/zJg2z1LF6ck
and visit our website: https://www.right-hear.com/
and download our app on google play or app store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.righthear
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/righthear/id1061791840
